reviews.text: Friendly professional kind and good job on all my fur babies I recommend to everyone
They care about your pet. Always kind. Always returns my Spicey girl happy, clean, and smelling yummy. Love love love Bubbles on Bev! Thank you for always taking excellent care of my baby.

Now that I'm less angry, Be SKEPTICAL about when you choose to drop your dog off. Trust your gut not the attendant. I've been to other locations and had flawless service. I ended up paying 50$ more here than I do anywhere else for the same service.

I have been coming here for over 15 years.

They groom Somi (Maltese) for 10 years until she passed away, and now Bom (Maltipoo) for 5 years, giving her such beautiful grooming.

I don't think there is a place in LA that grooms better than this.

The owner is also wonderful, and I hope they stay in business for a long time.
Love Bubbles grooming . They are fast and give a nice haircut to my baby doggy 🐩 …
She’s always in a rush and that makes her job not good . There are times she does a good job. It’s a hit or miss. And also hard to communicate .
They do a fantastic job with my dogs. The price is a little high but they leave very clean and with wonderful hair cuts.
They tried to charge me $25 for a nail trim.
Excellent work, I loved how they did with my Roxxy. The staff is very friendly and helpful and they care a lot about the well-being of our pets.

my late mother took all our dogs here. its been years, even before they moved to the Beverly location. owner is super nice & caring :) somehow i always come back here. as of now, i have a chihuahua that is 16yrs old. bubbles grooming takes care of her cautiously bc her eye, hearing, & teefs aint well 🥺 let them know where & how to becareful w your pet in advance!! BUBBLES GROOMING is on point, they care for your babies :)
Thank you for my dog's haircut. Bubbles Dog grooming did it quickly and efficiently 👍🏼. My dog and I are happy. …
We love their service! Really recommend!
My dogs were so clean and fluffy !
They charged me $85 dollars and they left a couple cuts on my dog. The worst part is they do not even tell you they did it. First and last time coming here. A day later the cuts were worse.
